definitions.gloss: completion ceremony; opening ceremony (of a building or structure)
definitions.explanation: A ceremony held when construction of a building, bridge, or other structure is finished, to celebrate its completion and thank those involved.

examples.japanese: {竣工式|しゅんこうしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{校舎|こうしゃ}→校舎：02801_kousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{竣工式|しゅんこうしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The completion ceremony for the new school building was held.

examples.japanese: {竣工式|しゅんこうしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テープ→テープ：01535_teepu⟧⟦カット→カット：10818_katto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祝|いわ}った→祝う：01881_iwau⟧。
examples.english: At the completion ceremony, the mayor cut the ribbon to celebrate the finished bridge.

notes:
⟦{竣工|しゅんこう}→竣工：16491_shunkou⟧ (completion of construction) + {式|しき} (ceremony). A formal word used for public buildings, company facilities, bridges and the like; for a private house people rarely hold one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {竣工式|しゅんこうしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ / ⟦{執|と}り{行|おこな}う→執り行う：19902_toriokonau⟧: to hold a completion ceremony
- {竣工式|しゅんこうしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招|まね}かれる→招く：02425_maneku⟧: to be invited to a completion ceremony
- {竣工式|しゅんこうしき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{祝賀会|しゅくがかい}→祝賀会：17147_shukugakai⟧: the ceremony and the reception after it

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{落成式|らくせいしき}→落成式：25608_rakuseishiki⟧: completion ceremony — nearly the same; slightly more common for halls and public buildings
- ⟦{上棟式|じょうとうしき}→上棟式：31098_joutoushiki⟧: roof-raising ceremony, held midway through construction
- ⟦{起工式|きこうしき}→起工式：23578_kikoushiki⟧: groundbreaking ceremony, held when work starts
